violations.description: Person in charge. — --Certified food service manager has an expired certificate
Preventing contamination by employees. — --Employee observed handling ready-to-eat food cheese slices with bare hands.
Preventing contamination of packaged and unpackaged food. — --Raw animal food was not properly separated from raw or cooked ready-to-eat food - Raw hamburger above cooked chicken.

Date marking and disposition of ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food. — --Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food (prepared more than 24 hours ago) was not properly date marked. - Items in walk-in cooler found with no date--Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food was not consumed/discarded within 10 calendar days from the date of preparation. - Many items found in walk-in cooler with 9/19 date.
Handwashing lavatories. — --Handwashing lavatory was not kept clean - At time of inspection a sanitizer bucket and spatula was found in sink
General employee practices. — --Food employee observed without proper hair restraint. -Cook without beard net.

Date marking and disposition of ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food. — --Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food (prepared more than 24 hours ago) was not properly date marked. - Items in reach-in cooler without dates.
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. - Shelving, handles on equipment needs to be cleaned.
Handwashing lavatories. — --Handwashing lavatory was not kept clean or maintained. - Hand wash station on cook line found dirty.
Designed, constructed, installed, and maintained (2 pts deducted)
